continuationGovernor.stopReason: Owner production testing exposed a Tote-only PostgreSQL deserialization defect. PR 12 fixed the exact root cause and is merged into canonical with full pre-merge CI and Browser QA green, and canonical CI is green. The required canonical live production matrix ran before the new canonical Vercel deployment because Vercel rejected commit 33cc9119 with its free-tier build-rate limit. The live matrix therefore hit the prior deployment: Tee M/Bone and Hat OS/Bone passed, while Tote OS reproduced the old 500. Do not call the Tote production path fixed until Vercel deploys the canonical repair and the live Tee/Hat/Tote matrix is rerun successfully.
